summary: CPython 3.11.18, 3.12.16, 3.13.18, 3.14.10, and 3.15.2 distrust the compromised eMudhra intermediate keys in the ssl module and reject a tarfile link that replaces the extraction destination. Older builds on those lines do not. A two-component tag on those lines names no patch. Python 3.16 and newer are outside this comparison.
remediation: Install Python 3.15.2, 3.14.10, 3.13.18, 3.12.16, or 3.11.18, or a newer build on that same line. A 3.10 or older install has no release on its line that includes this denylist.
